concepts.prompt:
Use case: logo-brand.
Edit target: supplied Coordinates logo presentation for Desegnos.
Preserve concept: a standalone D made entirely of discrete points, and that EXACT D scaled as the first letter of "Desegnos". Preserve two equal panels: black logo on plain white, identical white logo on plain black. Large mark above wordmark in each panel. Only text "Desegnos", spelled D-e-s-e-g-n-o-s.
Refine D: replace the awkward oval dot arrangement with an elegantly proportioned typographic capital D. Truly straight vertical left stem; short horizontal top and bottom shoulders meeting a smooth semicircular right bowl. Wider, calmer, more balanced than original, width around 78 percent of height. About 16 equal perfectly circular dots placed with OPTICALLY EVEN gaps along this precise D contour. Top and bottom left dots have exact vertical alignment. No pointy summit, no egg shape, no loading spinner. Every dot identical in diameter, no connecting strokes. Deliberate sophisticated spacing.
Wordmark integration: D sits exactly on the same baseline and cap height as the chosen typeface, with optical overshoot only. D must feel like its first letter, never a detached oversized icon. Tighten the overly wide original tracking to natural expertly kerned spacing. Match dot diameter and visual weight to the text; the dotted D must not overwhelm the rest of the name. Preserve enough gap between D and e to read clearly, same visual rhythm as the other letters. D symbol and initial D use identical construction.
Flat clean vector-like identity; no texture, no shadow, no gradients, no 3D, no added symbols. Show identical geometry in light and dark.
Typography direction A: inspired by MANROPE MEDIUM, a refined contemporary geometric sans serif with a generous x-height, round o, open e, crisp terminals and measured proportions. Use proportionally spaced lettering, no monospaced or techno forms. Restrained, precise, polished, fairly compact natural tracking. The circular dot motif should relate to the o and bowls of the text. Avoid ultra-bold weight.
